title: Museum Row Tour: Space, Dinosaurs and Sports at Exposition Park
includes: Natural History Museum Ticket if Option Selected ($18 value)
Natural History Museum Ticket if NOT Selected (not included)

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
What do the Olympics, Space Shuttle, Tyrannosaurus Rex and Pope all have in common? Exposition Park. Come discover the vast and storied history of a beloved Los Angeles landmark on an expertly guided tour of the California Science Center, Natural History Museum and more.

Exposition Park may seem like just another collection of metropolitan museums, but it's actually an epicenter of history and culture. During this 1.5 hour walking tour we will explore themes of nature, science, history, and astronomy as the guide takes you on a journey through space and time. Fun for the whole family or avid museumgoer!

Come join us and elevate your museum experience to gain deeper insights of this beautiful and often overlooked part of LA with our knowledgeable and friendly tour guides.
